description: This file sets up signal handling for the SIGINT signal, outputs messages upon receiving the signal, and schedules an exit after a delay. It also contains a periodic log that should not be reached under normal operation.

methods.name: <anonymous callback for process.on('SIGINT')>
methods.description: Handles the SIGINT signal, writes 'exited', and then schedules termination after 500ms.

methods.name: <anonymous callback for setTimeout>
methods.description: Writes ' fine' and then schedules process exit via process.nextTick.

methods.name: <anonymous callback for setInterval>
methods.description: Logs a message indicating it should not be reached under normal circumstances.
